You'd like to meet Carol for a minimum of 120 minutes. Patricia will be at Chinatown from 8:00PM to 9:30PM. You'd like to meet Patricia for a minimum of 75 minutes. Karen will be at The Castro from 5:00PM to 7:00PM. You'd like to meet Karen for a minimum of 45 minutes. Nancy will be at Presidio from 11:45AM to 10:00PM. You'd like to meet Nancy for a minimum of 30 minutes. Jeffrey will be at Pacific Heights from 8:00PM to 8:45PM. You'd like to meet Jeffrey for a minimum of 45 minutes. Matthew will be at Russian Hill from 3:45PM to 9:45PM. You'd like to meet Matthew for a minimum of 75 minutes.

{"itinerary": [{"action": "meet", "person": "<PERSON_NAME>", "start_time": "<HH:MM>", "end_time": "<HH:MM>"}]}. Make sure to include the person's name for each meeting.

Explanation of the chosen route:

• You start at Bayview at 9:00AM and travel 31 minutes to Presidio arriving well before Nancy’s availability. You then wait until 11:45AM to meet Nancy (minimum 30 minutes) at Presidio.
• Immediately after Nancy (at 12:15) you drive 14 minutes from Presidio to Russian Hill. Although Matthew isn’t available until 15:45, being already at his location minimizes later transit delays.
• At 15:45 you meet Matthew at Russian Hill for his full 75‑minute meeting (ends at 17:00).
• At 17:00 you leave Russian Hill for The Castro (21‑minute drive) to catch Karen whose window is 17:00–19:00. Arriving at 17:21 you meet her for her required 45 minutes (until 18:06).
• Next you drive 16 minutes from The Castro to Nob Hill (arriving about 18:22) and meet Paul for 60 minutes. His window of 16:15–21:15 easily allows a meeting from 18:22 to 19:22.
• Finally, you take a quick 6‑minute ride from Nob Hill to Chinatown (arriving at 19:28) and wait until 20:00 when Patricia is available. You then meet her for her needed 75 minutes (20:00–21:15) which fits within her 20:00–21:30 window.

This plan meets five friends (Nancy, Matthew, Karen, Paul and Patricia) while satisfying all minimum meeting durations and available time windows. (Other friends – Carol and Jeffrey – have windows so tight that including them would force unacceptable delays; thus this schedule maximizes the number of friends you can meet in the day.)
